definitions.explanation: A chair with supports for the arms. A compound of {肘掛|ひじか}け (armrest) and {椅子|いす} (chair).

examples.japanese: {肘掛|ひじか}け{椅子|いす}に{座|すわ}って{本|ほん}を{読|よ}む。
examples.english: I sit in the armchair and read a book.

examples.japanese: {革張|かわば}りの{肘掛|ひじか}け{椅子|いす}を{買|か}った。
{祖父|そふ}はいつも{居間|いま}の{肘掛|ひじか}け{椅子|いす}でうたた{寝|ね}をしていた。
examples.english: My grandfather always used to doze off in the armchair in the living room.

notes:
Compound of {肘掛|ひじか}け (armrest) + {椅子|いす} (chair). The native Japanese term for armchair, more commonly used than the loanword アームチェア.

FORMS:
{肘|ひじ} (elbow) + {掛|か}け (from {掛|か}ける, to rest on) = armrest
The same {掛|か}け pattern appears in {腰掛|こしか}け (seat/bench, lit. "hip rest").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肘掛|ひじか}け{椅子|いす}に{座|すわ}る: to sit in an armchair
- {肘掛|ひじか}け{椅子|いす}でくつろぐ: to relax in an armchair
- {革張|かわば}りの{肘掛|ひじか}け{椅子|いす}: leather armchair

RELATED CHAIR TYPES:
- {回転|かいてん}{椅子|いす}: swivel chair
- {折|お}りたたみ{椅子|いす}: folding chair
- ソファー: sofa
